summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K to disclose a Board of Directors declaration of Interest on Capital (IoC) of R$500 million (gross), or approximately R$0.1565 per share, with a 17.5% withholding tax, yielding a net R$0.1291 per share. The IoC will be considered as part of mandatory dividends for FY2026, ad referendum of the 2027 AGM. The record date is July 27, 2026, with payment by April 30, 2027. This is a routine capital return declaration, not a special situation event or tender offer. The shares will trade ex-IoC after the record date.
